title: Yellow Crunchy Polish Banana Pancakes
description: A rich and crunchy Polish dish featuring bananas and confit tomato, perfect for a solo dinner, made with low fat friendly ingredients. This recipe is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, mix together mashed bananas, confit tomato, and low fat milk.
Add the egg to the banana mixture and stir until well combined.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Heat a non stick pan over medium heat and add the butter.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into the pan.
Sprinkle crushed almonds on top of each pancake.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
